method: Three fresh implicit, unfunded NEAR wallets per baseline/candidate/control arm. Same corrected NEP-413 SDK, Gateway, Runtime, Console, Deriver A, Deriver B, custody configuration and requested APAC placement. Candidate changes Router and Signing Worker package delivery only. The final control restores the baseline custody versions.

initialFailures.cause: The capture proxy counted an empty cancelled upload as installed package delivery. The production server rejected the empty body. Count only a non-empty received package body.

Read-only Cloudflare settings included an empty placement object. Wrangler refused it before candidate publication. Omit the empty object, preserve actual settings, and repeat the controlled comparison.

Baseline tenant activation returned readiness_invalid while two US registration rows were pending. Wait for zero active regional ceremonies before changing baseline versions and activating the tenant.

reviewFindings.issue: Transport and channel failures used the malformed-payload error code.
reviewFindings.fix: Preserve InvalidLocalServiceConfig and the existing retryable HTTP 500 response.
reviewFindings.verification: early-delivery-failure E2E passed with initial HTTP 500 and unchanged persisted role outcomes.

deploymentCanaryFinding.behavior: The canary calls registration setup and returns a response digest without completing or cancelling the ceremony. Its pending records block the next readiness check until expiry.
deploymentCanaryFinding.resolution: Preserve the readiness check and wait for expiry. No unrelated product change or raw state mutation.

baselineServingVersionFailure.result: Three baseline registrations completed Yao but failed home completion with HTTP 400. Candidate was not deployed. Added a request-trace gate before timing samples.

mixedCustodyRollout.result: First two registrations reached baseline Router and candidate Signing Worker, which rejected the missing delivery address. Third registration used both candidate roles and succeeded. Excluded this rollout arm from the controlled comparison. Repeated after a two-minute stabilization interval with serving-version audit.

probeCorrection.result: The serving-version probe needed an explicit benchmark User-Agent and the existing protocol and environment headers. Corrected only the test script.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

completionAudit.note: A continuation completed the three measured arms after correcting the test-only serving probe. The original orchestrator retained its aborted measurement result and completed staging restoration.

discardedRolloutArm.cause: Two calls used baseline Router with candidate Signing Worker. Delivery failed closed because the old Router omitted the new address header. The third call used matching candidate roles and succeeded.

limitations: Three samples per arm do not establish percentiles or guarantees.
Sequential arms can vary with network and provider scheduling. Do not attribute the entire full-flow difference to delivery overlap.
The retained candidate and final control started two minutes after their role version changes. Every captured invocation version matched. Failed rollout arms are preserved separately.

The internal Router-to-Signing-Worker request contract changed. Deploy the matching cohort and verify actual serving versions before admitting registration traffic. A fixed delay alone is not a correctness guarantee.
Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Nested spans overlap and must not be added. The protocol spans include transport.
Application clocks do not advance during synchronous CPU work. Zero spans do not imply zero work.
The measured D1 events cover bound-root admission and execution, not all backend D1 calls.
Location hints are observed requests, not proof of physical colocation.
